routes.description: Liveness and readiness probes, for a load balancer and an orchestrator. Public, so a probe needs no credential.
The top-level container every project and task belongs to. Logo upload lives here; the rest is gRPC.
Preview and accept workspace invitations. Preview is public; accept needs a signed-in account.
Send a file to a task in chunks: open a session, put chunks (resumable), complete. Files suit REST better than gRPC.
Read an attachment: ask for a short-lived signed link, then fetch the bytes with it. Listing and deleting are gRPC.
Unsubscribe from a kind of notification email with the signed link in the email. The inbox itself is gRPC.
Upload a Jira, ClickUp, CSV or TaskForge export to import. Reading it, mapping, running and undoing are gRPC.
Download an export zip with the short-lived signed link that Exports.Status returns.

Sign in through a workspace's OpenID Connect provider: start (a browser redirect), callback, and the exchange of the one-time ticket for the usual credentials. No bearer token; the second-factor settings and SSO setup are gRPC.
Workspaces, projects, tasks and comments for scripts and integrations. Send Authorization: Bearer tf_... (an API token from Settings, Developer); its scopes narrow what its owner may do.
Make, list and revoke your API tokens. The secret is shown once, in the answer to the create call.
Workspace-owned identities for scripts: make one with a role, issue and list its tokens (revoke them at DELETE /tokens/{id}). A token holds the account's role intersected with its scopes.
Signed event deliveries to a URL: manage them, read the delivery log, send a delivery again or a test ping.
Upload the logo of an intake form (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB). Everything else about forms is gRPC.
Intake forms for people outside the workspace: read a form by its secret token and submit it (multipart, files allowed). No sign-in; also served at /api/public/forms.
